review_scope: Technical comparison of 23 paired composed physical views after correcting the shared native validator. This change affects test expectations and leaves production sources untouched.

images.observation: Front panel and pipe silhouettes match at the same station.
Shelves, panelling and distant umbrella retain their placement and finish.
Cistern, trim and tiled corner retain the same detail.
Both views show the same dark brick. The carrier is outside this frame.
Room geometry and surface details hold. Companion animation changes between frames.
Tile, curtain and companion are intact with a small shift of the light patch.
Furniture and resident retain placement. Companion tilt differs.
Far window, lamp, floor and furniture match with a small look shift.
Wall, counter and steel sink have the same coverage and light range.
Lid, controls and conduits remain visible with matching finishes.
The dim rail and cat silhouette match.
Sleeping cat, shelf and portrait retain the same shadows and outlines.
Shelf underside, brackets and cat match in low light.
Mail bank and bench retain placement and coverage.
Radiator and wooden window surround retain their contrast and shape.
Roof access rail and service runs retain the same detail.
Tank, frame and ledges match. Minor sky animation differs.
Terminal and station trim retain the same placement and finish.
Cistern and tiled walls match under comparable light.
Floor residue, radiator and companion remain visible with animation differences.
Growth and room finish boundaries hold. The animated growth pose differs.
Toaster, crumbs, kettle and countertop remain legible.
The same mounting and casing are visible. Fine details remain dim.
